operating_notes.text: Board recommended final dividend of Re. 1 per share and approved enabling resolutions to raise up to ₹35,000 Cr via debt and ₹20,000 Cr via equity.
Axis Finance Limited will issue 4,33,89,991 shares at ₹172.81 to Kedaara Pearl Holding and Kedaara Capital Fund IV AIF, reducing Axis Bank's stake to 94.92% from 100% on completion.
Advances grew 23% YoY to ₹13,73,727 Cr, with corporate loans up 34% and retail up 16%.
CASA ratio was 36% at Sep-2026, with CASA deposits of ₹5,29,539 Cr up 11% YoY.
CAR stood at 16.27% and CET-1 at 14.61%.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): interest earned ₹34,170.99 Cr (+5.3% YoY), net profit ₹7,602.63 Cr (+1.7% YoY).
On April 25, 2026, Axis Bank recommended a final dividend of Re. 1 per share and approved fundraising up to ₹35,000 Cr via debt and ₹20,000 Cr via equity.

On April 25, 2026, Axis Bank's board noted a proposed preferential issue by subsidiary Axis Finance to Kedaara entities at ₹172.81 a share, which will cut the Bank's stake to 94.92% from 100% on completion.
Axis Bank scheduled its 32nd AGM for July 31, 2026, and fixed July 10, 2026 as the dividend record date.
Axis Bank informed the exchanges about the audio recording of its Q4 and FY26 earnings call held on April 25, 2026.
On April 30, 2026, Axis Bank filed the transcript of its Q4FY26 earnings call.
On May 19, 2026, Axis Bank participated in the Motilal Oswal Annual Singapore Corporate Day, meeting with institutional investors.
Axis Bank approved an additional equity investment of up to ₹380.60 Cr in Axis Max Life Insurance, raising Axis Entities' stake to 19.99%.
On June 1, 2026, Axis Bank participated in the BofA India Conference 2026, interacting with institutional investors.
Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC), via Executive Director (Investment Back Office) S. K. Srivastava, declared no new encumbrances on Axis Bank shares beyond prior disclosures for FY2026.
Axis Bank released the transcript of its Q1FY27 earnings call held on July 18, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): interest earned ₹38,087.48 Cr (+17.9% YoY), net profit ₹7,704.66 Cr (+39.4% YoY).
Axis Bank reported Q2FY27 standalone PAT of ₹7,003 Cr, up 38% YoY, with GNPA at 1.16% and NIM at 3.36%.
